rows.definition: Per-batch dedupe map marking *model.Sessions already consumed while validating V41 step-cohort lanes, so an aliased lane referencing the same session is rejected.
rows.distinction: Ephemeral validation scratch local to one batch call; it neither owns nor persists sessions and plays no scheduling role.

rows.definition: NativeScheduler hook func(*model.Session) applied to every lane session the scheduler mints (fresh or restored) before use, e.g. binding the device backend a P/D decode role resolved.
rows.distinction: A mutation hook installed once via SetSessionDecorator before the first Admit; it is not a session record, makes no scheduling decision, and owns no session state.

rows.definition: ContinuousBatcher field mapping active session IDs to their *Slot so each step can look up the slot that owns a submitted session.
rows.distinction: An in-flight lookup index over live batching slots; it is not completedMap (finished sessions), not a gateway session registry, not the SessionCap capacity field, and persists nothing.

rows.definition: The unit classifying which store/durability tier a session's context belongs to (ctxplan.SessionScope int) and carrying WIP-attribution options (wipattr.SessionScope struct).
rows.distinction: Classifies where a session's data lives; it is not a lifecycle phase, not a gateway seat, and allocates no resources.

rows.definition: The first timed bench stage - bringing the backend session up before prefill - reported under the "session_setup" key in modelbench and qwen38campaign phase maps.
rows.distinction: A stage label naming a phase; it is not the measured duration of that phase (SessionSetupDuration) and not any other stage such as prefill or teardown.

rows.definition: Wall time spent setting up the backend session before prefill in a raw-decode trial, exposed as TimingObservation.SessionSetupDuration() and execution.Runs[i].SessionSetupDuration.
rows.distinction: The measured duration of the session_setup stage; it is not the stage label itself and not PrefillDuration, FirstSampleDuration, or DecodeDuration.

rows.definition: Display title (json "session_title") attached to a spawned opencode session, e.g. "Issue #N: <title>", carried on debtlane UnitOfWork and issueorchestrator spawn records.
rows.distinction: A human-readable label for a spawned session; it is not a session ID, not a verdict, not part of the drive record, not the SessionTime clock snapshot, and not the SessionFile image filename.

rows.definition: valueSizeTracker method storing the observed slot-utilization ratio so shard rebalancing can compare it against its target.
rows.distinction: Writes the tracker's stored value; it is not the allocator's read-only SlotUtilization(requestSize) ratio method and reports no metric itself.

rows.definition: Byte capacity of one transfer/stream slot - the AMD GPUDirect APU TBV2 per-slot payload budget and the ExpertStreamQueue.SlotBytes() accessor.
rows.distinction: A size in bytes; it is not a position (SlotIndex), not occupancy (UsedSlots), and not expert weight-slot bindings (fusedVulkanSlotBytesOKLocked).

rows.definition: The raw byte-payload view of an allocated L3-server slot (BitmapAllocator.SlotData(offset)) and the decoded expert-weight buffer handed to GLM5NextExpertCodec.Decode.
rows.distinction: The content of a slot; it is not the slot's position (SlotIndex), its key (SlotKey), or its utilization (SlotUtilization).

rows.definition: Positional index of a slot within a fixed slot array or queue - AQL doorbell queues, pacing leases (json slot_index), transient Vulkan plans, and MoE double buffers.
rows.distinction: A zero-based position; it is not an identity key (SlotKey), not a byte size (SlotBytes), not occupancy (UsedSlots), and not the short SlotID wire form.

rows.definition: Deterministic key identifying a slot - the cron fire-slot key that dedupes scheduled fires (cronFireSlot) and the cuckoo CAS table-slot key.
rows.distinction: An identity used for lookup and dedupe; it is not a positional index (SlotIndex) and not the slot's content (SlotData).

rows.definition: The candidate KV slot-count list enumerated during fit-plan search, crossed with context lengths to score deployment rows.
rows.distinction: A search dimension over hypothetical configurations; it is not live occupancy (UsedSlots) and not an actual slot array.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher slot lifecycle phase meaning the slot holds no session and is ready for admission.
rows.distinction: The idle phase of a continuous-batching slot; it is not the model-package Slot free/busy signal and not any other lifecycle phase.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher slot lifecycle phase in which the slot is resident and emitting decode tokens one at a time.
rows.distinction: The steady-state decode phase of a continuous-batching slot; it is not the prefill phase, not a yield, and not the model-package Slot free/busy signal.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher slot lifecycle phase in which the slot runs budgeted, resumable prompt chunks before it activates for decode.
rows.distinction: The chunked-prompt phase of a continuous-batching slot; it is not active decode, not a yield, and not the model-package Slot free/busy signal.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher slot lifecycle phase in which the slot yielded mid-step awaiting I/O and will resume later.
rows.distinction: A paused-awaiting-I/O phase of a continuous-batching slot; it is not active decode, not finished, and not the model-package Slot free/busy signal.

rows.definition: Continuous-batcher slot lifecycle phase in which the slot has produced its output and is being drained back to empty.
rows.distinction: The terminal phase of a continuous-batching slot; it is not active decode, not a yield, and not the model-package Slot free/busy signal.

rows.definition: Ratio of average request bytes to slot-class size (1.0 = perfect fit, lower = more waste) returned by the L3 Allocator interface and reported in slab metrics.
rows.distinction: A waste-measuring ratio; it is not the count of occupied slots (UsedSlots), not a byte size (SlotBytes), and not the shard-tracker setter (SetSlotUtilization).

rows.definition: schedLane method that, under lock, acquires the next *model.Session to run on a model from the native scheduler's pending set.
rows.distinction: Acquires a session for scheduling; it is not the SeenSessions alias guard, not the sessionDecorator hook, and mutates no session content.

rows.definition: Adapter converting session.Verdict to gateway.SessionVerdict when session-admission outcomes cross into the gateway plane.
rows.distinction: A type-conversion helper between two verdict types; it is not a verdict itself and makes no admission decision.

rows.definition: Count of slots currently occupied in an L3 slab class or shard (SlabClassSnapshot.UsedSlots), the numerator of slot utilization.
rows.distinction: A count of occupied slots; it is not the utilization ratio (SlotUtilization), not the total slot count, and not a free-slot event (SlotFreed).

rows.definition: internal/workspaceslot package providing a leased slot ring (SlotRing with TryAcquire/release) that bounds concurrent workspace dispatch.
rows.distinction: A concurrency-lease primitive for workspaces; it is not an engine continuous-batching slot (SlotState phases), not an L3 memory-allocation slot, and not a bench stage.

rows.definition: sessionimage helper marshaling a drive's session State to session.json when BranchDir writes a fresh drive; harnessweb carries a same-spelled HTTP JSON envelope writer for session cards.
rows.distinction: Persists or emits session state as JSON; it is not the session-move journal writer and changes no session content.
